name: Manago AI (formerly SALESmanago)
description_en:
Manago AI is the current name of SALESmanago. It combines customer data, marketing automation and commerce-oriented engagement. This profile concentrates on its documented Workflow engine, where an event can lead through conditions to communication or contact-management actions. The rebrand also introduces agentic AI positioning, but sibling brands Leadoo AI and Thulium AI remain separately described products.

An evaluation should distinguish three questions: whether a contact qualifies for a workflow, whether the chosen channel has the required consent, and whether the purchased package includes that capability. Current commercial packaging and older SALESmanago terminology coexist in official documentation. Reported revenue attribution and AI marketing claims are vendor descriptions, not independently measured incremental sales.
description_zh:
Manago AI 是 SALESmanago 的现用名称，结合客户数据、营销自动化与面向电商的互动功能。本文聚焦有操作文档的 Workflow 引擎：事件经过条件判断后执行消息或联系人管理动作。更名也引入智能体 AI 定位，但同族品牌 Leadoo AI、Thulium AI 仍是分别介绍的产品。

评估应区分三个问题：联系人是否满足流程资格、所选渠道是否具备相应同意、购买组合是否包含该能力。当前商业组合与文档中的旧 SALESmanago 术语并存。收入归因及 AI 营销主张是供应商描述，未独立测量增量销售。

core_features.explanation_en: Behavior-driven paths can execute messaging and contact operations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 行为驱动路径可执行消息及联系人操作。

core_features.explanation_en: Wait for an event with a required timeout route.
core_features.explanation_zh: 等待事件，并配置必需超时路径。

core_features.explanation_en: A selected consent prompt controls eligibility for this action.
core_features.explanation_zh: 所选同意提示控制该动作资格。

core_features.explanation_en: Touchpoint and last-click views have different definitions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 触点及末次点击视图具有不同定义。

en: Evaluate an ecommerce recovery journey where purchase timing determines the next action.
Assess a lead-handoff rule that must distinguish score changes from first qualification.
Plan a consent migration with separate status and event checks.
zh: 评估由购买时间决定后续动作的电商挽回流程。
评估必须区分分数变化与首次达标的线索交接规则。
规划分别检查状态及事件的同意迁移。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Identify the current package and required modules.
steps.zh: 确认当前组合及所需模块。

steps.en: Map the trip event, timeout and Finish path.
steps.zh: 绘制本次事件、超时及 Finish 路径。

steps.en: Review opt-out imports separately from event execution.
steps.zh: 分别核对退出导入及事件执行。

steps.en: Use the documented controlled-contact test before broad activation.
steps.zh: 全面启用前采用文档中的可控联系人测试。

items.en: Same-workflow overlap is unavailable before Finish.
items.zh: 到达 Finish 前不能在同一流程重叠参与。

items.en: A downward score change can still meet the above-threshold event.
items.zh: 分数下降仍可能满足高于阈值事件。

items.en: Opt-out imports do not prove that an opt-out event workflow fired.
items.zh: 导入退出状态不证明退出事件流程触发。

items.en: Exact handling choices for existing participants require the actual account dialog.
items.zh: 已有参与者处理选项需查看实际账户对话框。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current base amount was not exposed. Platform fees depend on active contacts; email/web push are described as unlimited, while SMS/WhatsApp, optional modules and onboarding are extra. Monthly and one-/two-/three-year contracts differ. Contact growth is priced per 1,000, with higher overage rates. The consent/activity definition conflict above must be resolved before estimating billable contacts.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前页面未呈现基础金额。平台按活跃联系人计费，邮件／网页推送称不限量；SMS/WhatsApp、可选模块及入门服务另收费。月付及一／二／三年合约价格不同。联系人按每千人增长收费，超额费率较高。估算计费人数前须澄清上述同意／活动定义冲突。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Identify the current product before comparing packages
sections.title_zh: 比较组合前确认现用产品
sections.en: The official brand story confirms the transition from SALESmanago to Manago AI and describes a simpler AI-led experience. That establishes identity continuity, not that every old package retains the new packaging or that sibling contact-centre and conversion products are included. Editorial evaluation: record the account generation, contracted modules and workflow terminology on a single checklist before comparing quotes or migrating an existing automation.
sections.zh: 官方品牌故事确认 SALESmanago 转为 Manago AI，并描述更简化的 AI 体验。这证明品牌延续，不代表全部旧套餐保留新组合，或同族客服中心、转化产品均包含。编辑评估建议：比较报价或迁移现有自动化前，在同一清单记录账户代际、签约模块及流程术语。

sections.title_en: One path per contact, with re-entry after Finish
sections.title_zh: 单联系人单路径，到达 Finish 后可重入
sections.en: Start accepts events; multiple triggers use OR, and simultaneous triggers select a path randomly. A contact has one position in a workflow and cannot re-enter it before Finish, although different workflows can overlap. Saving and activation are required. Editing or deactivation requires a decision about existing participants; the dialog options were not readable as text. Editorial check: define which external event identifies this trip before enabling it.
sections.zh: Start 接收事件，多入口使用 OR，同时触发随机选择路径。联系人在同一流程只有一个位置，Finish 前不能重入，但可同时进入不同流程。需要保存并激活。编辑或停用要求决定已有参与者如何处理；对话框选项未取得可读文字。编辑检查：启用前定义代表本次参与的外部事件。

sections.title_en: A conditional event can finish waiting earlier
sections.title_zh: 条件事件可提前结束等待
sections.en: Wait followed by a condition checks only after the delay. A conditional event advances when the event arrives, with a mandatory time limit and alternative connector for non-arrival. Contact-added and approaching-dictionary-date events are start-only exceptions. For an editorial replenishment journey, decide whether a purchase should end waiting immediately or only be checked at a later checkpoint; those choices produce different response times.
sections.zh: Wait 后接 Condition 在延迟结束后检查。条件事件在行为发生时立即前进，必须设置时限及未发生的替代出口。新增联系人、字典日期将到／已到事件只能作为入口。编辑补货流程示例：明确购买后立即结束等待，还是稍后检查点才核对；两种选择的响应时间不同。

sections.title_en: Do not treat every branch as a random experiment
sections.title_zh: 不能把每个分支都当作随机实验
sections.en: Selected conditions support up to six paths, including one unmet route. A/B/X instead randomly allocates contacts across up to four paths whose percentages total 100%. Editorial design: separate eligibility rules from an experiment. Use mutually intelligible branch criteria, keep the intended business outcome comparable and inspect consent eligibility before attributing a performance difference to message content. No statistical significance or automatic winning-variant guarantee was verified.
sections.zh: 部分条件支持最多六条路径，包含一条未满足路径。A/B/X 则按合计 100% 的比例随机分配到最多四路。编辑设计建议：资格规则与实验分开，使用易理解的分支条件、保持业务目标可比较，并在把效果差异归于内容前检查渠道同意资格。未核实统计显著性或自动采用胜出版本的保证。

sections.title_en: A score-above event can fire on a decrease
sections.title_zh: 高于阈值事件也可能在分数下降时触发
sections.en: Contact scoring changed to more than evaluates a changed score above the threshold, rather than only an upward crossing. The official example allows 162 to 160 when the threshold is 150. Changes during an unfinished trip do not create another entry; a later change after Finish can. Editorial lead-handoff check: if the intended signal is newly qualified rather than any qualifying change, model that state explicitly and verify both increasing and decreasing examples. Do not assume ignored mid-trip changes are queued for replay.
sections.zh: Contact scoring changed to more than 检查变化后的分数是否高于阈值，不只检查向上跨越。官方示例中阈值 150 时，162 降为 160 仍可触发。未完成期间的变化不会新增参与，Finish 后的新变化可再触发。编辑线索交接建议：若目标是首次达标而非任意达标变化，应明确建模该状态，并验证升分及降分示例。不能假设参与期间忽略的变化会排队重放。

sections.title_en: A changed consent status and a fired event differ
sections.title_zh: 同意状态变化与生成事件不同
sections.en: The email opt-out event covers unsubscribe links, Contact Card edits and API changes with fireEvents enabled, which is documented as the default. Creating a contact already opted out and CSV/XLSX imports do not fire it; bulk Contact Manager changes require the Workflow execution selection. This describes event production, not a claim that imported opt-outs are ignored by sending. Separately, Send Web Push requires the selected prompt’s consent and no withdrawal. Editorial migration check: validate stored consent and the downstream reaction separately; one successful status import does not demonstrate that the reaction workflow ran.
sections.zh: 邮件退出事件覆盖退订链接、Contact Card 编辑及启用 fireEvents 的 API 变更（文档默认启用）。新建时已退出、CSV/XLSX 导入不生成事件，Contact Manager 批量操作需选择执行 Workflow。这描述事件生成，不能解释为发送时忽略导入的退订。另行地，Send Web Push 要求所选提示的同意且未撤回。编辑迁移建议：分别验证存储同意及下游响应；状态导入成功不证明响应流程运行。

sections.title_en: The documented test activates a real workflow
sections.title_zh: 文档测试需要激活真实流程
sections.en: The guide tests with a contact in a saved, active workflow and a unique-tag condition limiting access. It is therefore an operational test, not an offline simulation. Editorial acceptance: use controlled recipients and harmless assets, exercise both outcomes and inspect the resulting contact history before removing the test filter. This research executed no account actions or sends.
sections.zh: 指南使用已保存、激活流程中的测试联系人，并用独有标签条件限制访问，因此属于真实操作测试，不能当作离线模拟。编辑验收建议：使用可控收件人及无害素材，覆盖两侧结果，检查联系人历史后再移除测试条件。本研究未执行账户操作或发送。

sections.title_en: Attributed revenue does not establish incremental revenue
sections.title_zh: 归因收入不证明增量收入
sections.en: Driven revenue includes a workflow communication among the last 25 marketing interactions within 90 days before purchase; last-click attribution requires the final touchpoint to originate from a workflow. These are different windows and should not be added as independent revenue. Email OR and CTR use sent emails as denominator; the dashboard’s text-message opens cover WhatsApp/Viber rather than SMS. Editorial reporting: name the attribution model beside each amount and compare purchases against the transaction source before describing a campaign as causal.
sections.zh: Driven 收入要求购买前 90 天内最后 25 次营销互动包含工作流消息；末次点击归因要求最终触点来自工作流。两者口径不同，不能作为独立收入相加。邮件 OR、CTR 以发送量为分母；仪表盘文字消息打开量包含 WhatsApp/Viber 而非 SMS。编辑报告建议：金额旁注明归因模型，并与交易来源核对后再讨论活动因果效果。

sections.title_en: Resolve the active-contact definition in the quote
sections.title_zh: 报价中需澄清活跃联系人定义
sections.en: The pricing FAQ lists any channel opt-in or purchase/cart activity within 180 days as qualifying, then says records without marketing consent do not count. Purchase-only eligibility is consequently unresolved. AI Starter is included in a paid licence, with usage pausing at the cap until reset or a chosen upgrade; this is not evidence of a permanently free platform.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 把任一渠道同意，或 180 天内购买／加购列为资格，随后又说没有营销同意的记录不计费。因此仅购买者是否计费仍不明确。AI Starter 随付费许可包含，额度用尽后暂停，直到重置或主动升级；这不构成平台永久免费证据。

seo.title_en: Manago AI workflows: events, consent and pricing
seo.title_zh: Manago AI 工作流：事件、同意及价格
seo.description_en: Examine Manago AI workflow entry, score events, consent-import behavior, live testing and current pricing gaps.
seo.description_zh: 核对 Manago AI 工作流入口、分数事件、同意导入、真实测试及当前价格缺口。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate SALESmanago / Manago AI marketing automation behavior and commercial fit
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Exact current platform price, active-contact conflict resolution and full commercial terms were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实当前平台准确价格、活跃联系人冲突解释及完整商业条款。

research_gaps.en: Existing-participant edit/deactivation choices appeared as images; exact alternatives, pause timers and recovery/retry guarantees remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 已有参与者编辑／停用选项呈现为图片；准确选项、暂停计时及恢复／重试保证未核实。

research_gaps.en: Current identity redirects from salesmanago.com to manago.ai; legacy identity retained for the fixed record. Shared same-domain validation is not evidence against the official migration.
research_gaps.zh: 当前身份由 salesmanago.com 跳转 manago.ai；固定记录保留旧身份。共享同域校验不能否认官方迁移。

research_gaps.en: No hands-on sends, causal outcome measurement, current integration execution, source licence, self-hosting, UI-language list or comprehensive regional availability was verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未进行实际发送、因果效果测量，也未核实当前集成执行、源码许可、自托管、界面语言清单及完整地区可用性。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
